visual_elements.description: Scaled Dot-Product Attention panel. Tan rounded-rectangle container; red italic two-line title 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' at top-left inside. Green L-shaped corner brackets with small green squares frame the inner chart. Bottom-up nodes: three circles Q (red), K (blue), V (purple); arrow from Q and K up into 'MatMul' (beige box); up to 'Scale'; up to 'Mask (opt.)'; up to 'SoftMax'; up to top 'MatMul'; V (purple) feeds the top MatMul via an arrow running up the right side (small diagonal tick near V). Black arrows connect all nodes bottom-to-top.

Multi-Head Attention panel. Thin green rectangle border with small green filled squares at the four corners; red italic title 'Multi-Head Attention' above the border. Bottom-up: three circles V (blue), K (blue), q (red); three parallel arrows into three white 'Linear' boxes; three arrows into a horizontal stack of 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention' boxes — front box lavender/purple fill with red border and dark-red text, 3-4 gray/white offset copies behind it representing parallel heads; annotation 'h' with a small pointer arrow at the right of the stack; arrow up to pale-yellow 'Concat' box; arrow up to white 'Linear' box at top.

Full Transformer architecture. ENCODER container: peach rounded rectangle, red italic label 'Encoder' top-left. Stack bottom-up: red up-arrow labeled 'Inputs' below container; tan box 'Input Embedding'; circle-plus junction with small tan circle to its left and gray label 'Positional Encoding' at far left; gray box 'Add & Norm'; tan box 'Multi-Head Attention' outlined in red (highlighted) with circles V (green), K (blue), Q (red) beneath feeding it; gray box 'Add & Norm'; gray box 'Feed Forward'; gray label 'Nx' at right of the stack. DECODER container: light-green rounded rectangle with green border, green italic label 'Decoder' top-right. Stack bottom-up: red up-arrow labeled 'Outputs (shifted right)'; maroon box 'Output Embedding'; circle-plus junction with maroon circle to left and gray label 'Positional Encoding' at far right; purple box 'Masked Multi-Head Attention' with circles V (blue), K (blue), Q (red) beneath; gray box 'Add & Norm'; tan box 'Multi-Head Attention' outlined in red (highlighted) with circles V (green), K (blue), Q (red) beneath; gray box 'Add & Norm'; gray box 'Feed Forward'; gray box 'Add & Norm'; white box 'Linear'; white box 'Softmax'; red up-arrow at top labeled 'Output Probabilities'; gray label 'Nx' at right. A red dashed curved arrow sweeps from the decoder's right edge (near Multi-Head Attention) up toward the 'Decoder' label at top-right.

Bright yellow rectangle placed behind the decoder's upper stack (roughly from the decoder Multi-Head Attention up through Add & Norm / Feed Forward / Add & Norm), overlapping the encoder container's right edge to emphasize the decoder processing block.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations; all graphics are vector-style flowchart shapes: colored circles representing Q/K/V vectors, rounded rectangles for layers, circle-plus symbols for positional-encoding junctions, red block arrows for inputs/outputs, a dark-red speech-bloon icon 'WE ARE HERE', and green viewfinder-style corner brackets.
typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Arial/Calibri-like). Title is large (~36-40pt) bold red. Container titles ('Encoder', 'Decoder', 'Scaled Dot-Product Attention', 'Multi-Head Attention') are bold italic in red or green. Layer-box labels are small (~9-10pt) bold black or dark gray. 'WE ARE HERE' is bold white all-caps. Slide number is red inside a yellow circle. Note inconsistent casing preserved verbatim: 'SoftMax' (left panel) vs 'Softmax' (decoder), and lowercase 'q' in the center panel vs uppercase 'Q' elsewhere.
